Class SceneManager

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am48.view.gui.SceneManager
public class SceneManager extends Object
Singleton-like manager for JavaFX scene transitions. Holds global references to the primary Stage, the server connection, the client model, and all shared resources (image cache, sound cache, card data registry, player nickname). Provides the changeScene(String) method to switch between FXML-based scenes.

    • changeScene

      public static Object changeScene(String fxmlPath)
      Loads an FXML file and switches the current scene root to the new layout. The scene dimensions (1280x720) are set on the first call.
      Parameters:
      fxmlPath - the path to the FXML resource file (e.g. "splash-screen.fxml")
      Returns:
      the controller of the newly loaded scene, or null if loading failed
